A lower layer never overrides a higher one; while V15.0 is not ADOPTED it never outranks (2)–(4). Re-evaluate this record if any status in 'sources' changes (the test fails when it does).

resolutions.rootCause: Layer confusion. §51 rule 1 ranks V15.0 among CAMPAIGN directives ('de cette campagne'); §51 rule 2 of the same list keeps V12.4 as the canonical Boussole until formal succession; V14.4 is the ADOPTED roadmap that organises the execution of V12.4. resolutions.resolution: RESOLVED_BY_PRECEDENCE (PREC-1 + SCOPE-1): V15.0 is the single directive OF the V15.0 campaign — binding only V15.0-campaign contracts — and, being PROPOSED, never outranks V12.4, V14.4 or the addendum. No owner text is edited. Formal adoption of V15.0 (OD-1) remains an owner decision but is not a contradiction.
